title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
script:
Dream just raised $17 million from Andreessen Horowitz to build AI world models.
The startup was founded by former Palantir executives.
They are building a model grounded in real physics and construction standards.
The engine is trained on over 100 million square feet of building data.
This data comes from official permit archives across the United States.
The goal is to provide a predictive tool for the architectural sector.
Would you let an AI draft your building plans?
